"""Evolvable cache replacement policy starting from LRU baseline."""

from collections import OrderedDict


class EvolvedCache:
    """Byte-based cache with evolvable replacement policy."""
    
    # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
    def __init__(self, capacity_bytes):
        self.capacity = capacity_bytes
        self.current_size = 0
        self.hits = 0
        self.misses = 0
        self.cache = OrderedDict()  # obj_id -> (obj_size, freq)
        self.freq = {}  # obj_id -> access count (persists across evictions)
    
    def access(self, obj_id, obj_size):
        """Process an access request. Returns True for hit, False for miss."""
        if obj_id in self.cache:
            size, f = self.cache[obj_id]
            new_f = min(f + 1, 31)
            self.freq[obj_id] = new_f
            self.cache[obj_id] = (size, new_f)
            self.cache.move_to_end(obj_id)
            self.hits += 1
            return True

        # Miss
        self.misses += 1
        f = self.freq.get(obj_id, 0) + 1
        self.freq[obj_id] = f

        # Skip objects larger than cache capacity
        if obj_size > self.capacity:
            return False

        # Value-based admission: compare incoming value vs worst cached item
        incoming_value = f / obj_size
        if self.current_size + obj_size > self.capacity and self.cache:
            worst_score = -1
            worst_id = None
            for eid, (esz, ef) in self.cache.items():
                score = esz / ef
                if score > worst_score:
                    worst_score = score
                    worst_id = eid
            worst_esz, worst_ef = self.cache[worst_id]
            worst_value = worst_ef / worst_esz
            if incoming_value < worst_value:
                return False

        # Evict: full scan, score = size / freq (large infrequent items evicted first)
        while self.current_size + obj_size > self.capacity and self.cache:
            best_score = -1
            best_id = None
            for eid, (esz, ef) in self.cache.items():
                score = esz / ef
                if score > best_score:
                    best_score = score
                    best_id = eid
            if best_id is None:
                best_id = next(iter(self.cache))
            esz, _ = self.cache.pop(best_id)
            self.current_size -= esz

        # Insert new object
        self.cache[obj_id] = (obj_size, f)
        self.current_size += obj_size
        return False
    # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
    
    def hit_rate(self):
        """Return the hit rate as a fraction."""
        total = self.hits + self.misses
        return self.hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0
